title: 🍔 Order Fast Food Like an American in 30 Seconds! #Shorts

subtitles.en:
Alex, if you walk into McDonald's in the US,
what's the first thing you say?
subtitles.zh: Alex，如果你在美國走進麥當勞，開口說的第一句話是什麼？

subtitles.en:
Can I get a number one combo, please? Why do
you ask?
subtitles.zh:
「請問我可以點一號套餐嗎？」（Can I get 溫和客氣）你怎麼突然
問這個？

subtitles.en:
Really? I always say: Give me number one!
Like a boss!
subtitles.zh: 真的嗎？我每次都直接說「給我一號餐！」像老大一樣命令店員！

subtitles.en:
To the cashier, Give me sounds like an
aggressive command!
subtitles.zh:
在店員耳裡，「Give me」聽起來像強硬無理的命令句！
（容易讓人不舒服）

subtitles.en:
Oh no! Did I scare them? What should I say
instead?
subtitles.zh: 天啊！我嚇到他們了嗎？那我該怎麼說？

subtitles.en:
Two golden phrases. Number one: Can I get a
number one combo, please?
subtitles.zh:
兩大黃金句型。第一，最得體的說法：「請問我可以點一號套餐嗎？
」（Can I get 溫和有禮）

subtitles.en:
Can I get... Soft and polite. What's number
two?
subtitles.zh: 「Can I get...」溫和又有禮貌。那第二種呢？

subtitles.en:
Number two is super natural: I'll go with the
cheeseburger combo, please.
subtitles.zh:
第二種超道地：「我選起司堡套餐好了。」（I'll go with 隨興
自然，就像順手做選擇）

subtitles.en:
I'll go with... Like making a quick pick!
What about upsizing?
subtitles.zh: 「I'll go with...」就像順手做選擇！那如果想升級大份呢？

subtitles.en: Super simple: Make it a large, please.
subtitles.zh:
超簡單：「幫我升級大份，謝謝！」（Make it a large 就是
升級大份）

subtitles.en: Make it a large! Got it! Anything else?
subtitles.zh: 「升級大份」學會了！還有其他關鍵細節嗎？

subtitles.en:
Now, here's the trickiest cashier question:
For here or to go?
subtitles.zh:
現在是店員必問的經典陷阱題：「請問內用還是外帶？
」（For here or to go）

subtitles.en:
Wait! I thought they asked: Four here? And I
said: No, just me!
subtitles.zh:
等等！我以前都以為他們問「這裡四位嗎？」我還回「不，
只有我一人！」超尷尬！

subtitles.en:
For here means dine-in, and to go means
takeout! Just say: To go, please!
subtitles.zh:
「For here」是內用，「to go」是外帶！
只要回答：「外帶，謝謝！」（To go, please!）

subtitles.en:
Golden rule: Can I get, I'll go with, and To
go, please!
subtitles.zh:
黃金法則：用 Can I get（禮貌）、
I'll go with（隨興），還有 To go,
please（外帶）！

subtitles.en:
What's your go-to fast food order? Tell us in
the comments, and subscribe for more tips!
subtitles.zh: 大家最喜歡點什麼速食？歡迎在留言區分享，也別忘了訂閱我們喔！
